title: Assistant prefill returns 400 on Claude Opus 4.6 and later models
symptoms: 400 invalid_request_error when the messages array ends with an assistant turn
A prefilled '{' that used to force JSON output stops working after a model upgrade
cause: Ending messages with a partial assistant turn for the model to continue is rejected on Opus 4.6 and later Opus models and on Haiku 5.5. Code that used prefill to force JSON or skip a preamble fails as soon as the model id changes.
fix: End messages with a user turn. Use structured outputs through output_config.format for JSON, or put the format rule in the system field. On Amazon Bedrock, where structured outputs are not offered for Opus 5.5, use instructions and validate the reply.
apply: output_config: { format: { type: "json_schema", schema: { type: "object", properties: { answer: { type: "string" } }, required: ["answer"], additionalProperties: false } } }
affected: Claude Opus 4.6, 4.7, 4.8, 5, 5.5 and Haiku 5.5 (Haiku 4.5 still accepts prefill), as of 2026-10
